title: Gravel and Steel
description: Adds a new shaped recipe for crafting flint and steel using gravel and an iron ingot.
body: Gravel and Steel is a simple mod that adds an extra shaped recipe for crafting Flint and Steel using Iron Ingot and Gravel. Just place the iron ingot in the top right slot and gravel in the center slot of the crafting table to get flint and steel. This mod is lightweight, compatible with other mods, and designed for Fabric.
